summary: PT/FM is a ProTracker-style tracker workstation where pattern tracks play synth engines and samples side by side, with a loop station and a two-deck DJ mode alongside the song editor.
features: Patterns of up to 16 tracks and 128 rows, four commands per cell
Engines: DX7 FM, JUNO-106, TB-303, retro sound chips, sampler, FUSION
Up to 16 voices; 11 built-in cartridges with 568 instruments
LOOPS loop station and DJ mode with two decks and a crossfader
USB and TRS MIDI in, USB MIDI out and clock, controller mode
USB audio; songs saved to 412 KB of flash on the device
